description_en: Retrieves a list of device log tasks
description_zh: 获取设备日志任务列表数据
kebab_example: aliyun emas-appmonitor get-tlog-collect-list --app-key 24780725 --os android --page-index 1 --page-size 30 --utdid Z70g6V/MXJ8DABtD53eHzn4X --author admin --status START --begin-date 1777996800000 --end-date 1777996800000 --keyword user_nick --model iphone --city hangzhou --app-version 1.0 --os-version 1 --source-type USER --create-begin-date 1777996800000 --create-end-date 1777996800000 --update-begin-date 1777996800000 --update-end-date 1777996800000 --positive-comment positiveComment --user-nick user_nick --device-id ad-0002nzx5r86f7jzrv0nx-91 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTlogCollectList

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the application
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type. Valid values:
iphoneos: iOS.
android: Android
parameters.help_zh:
os类型
iphoneos(苹果)
android(安卓)
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en: The page number
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The UTDID. This parameter is deprecated
parameters.name: utdid

parameters.help_en: The user who last modified the task
parameters.name: author

parameters.help_en:
The collection status. If this parameter is left empty, tasks in all states are queried. Valid values:
START: The task has been created and is waiting for the device to pull it.
PULL_REPLIED: The device has pulled the task.
FILE_SENDED: The log file information has been sent to the parsing pipeline.
FINISHED: The log retrieval succeeded.
FAIL_OVER: The log retrieval failed.
SUSPENDED: The log retrieval timed out.
CANCELLED: The task has been canceled
parameters.help_zh:
采集状态，为空查询全状态
START  任务已创建，等待设备拉取
PULL_REPLIED 设备已拉取到任务
FILE_SENDED 日志文件信息已发送给解析链路
FINISHED 日志拉取成功
FAIL_OVER 日志拉取失败
SUSPENDED 日志拉取超时
CANCELLED 任务已取消
parameters.name: status
